note: Two retired log landings along Rock Ridge Road, about 450 m apart, with access driveways about 1.9 miles (027 Landing A) and 2.3 miles (028 Landing B) from PA 44. The agency cautions that it is reached by dirt or gravel forest roads that may not suit low-clearance vehicles or large RVs. Stone fire rings; no table, toilet or water. Pack out trash. --Claude
